# Colour

Gives you one colour to share between connected nodes.

`lfs.colour` · Input

## How to use

Pick a colour, then connect Colour to the settings you want to share.  
The default is mid grey.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Colour | `Colour` | lfs.colour | [0.5, 0.5, 0.5] | step 0.01 | RGB colour, usually 0–1 per channel: 0 is black, 1 is white. The default (0.5, 0.5, 0.5) is mid grey. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Colour | `Colour` | lfs.colour | — | — | Resulting RGB colour. 0 is black and 1 is white per channel; some calculations can exceed this range. |
